notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 If Available ownership-acquisition service. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, two distinct attribute names on one class, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies unknown-object, undefined-attribute, unpublished-class, and unpublished-attribute API exception preconditions, nondivesting-owned unavailability without an owner release request, successful acquisition of an unowned attribute, exact callback metadata, tag preservation, ownership-state transitions, repeat-acquisition rejection, and federation cleanup. Under evoked callbacks it repeats an identical pending request before callback servicing and requires exactly one unavailable callback. A fresh-object mixed repeat then adds a second eligible attribute while preserving the first pending attribute; the TCK accepts one combined or two complementary acquisition notifications, requires both ownership transfers, and checks for no extra terminal callback. No pending-state timing assertion is made under immediate callbacks. The exception preconditions are API-contract evidence without separate pinned Requirements Lab candidate mappings. Negotiated-divestiture eligibility is not claimed: an offer-first experimental candidate failed the installed-package confirmation-callback gate and the request-first native case relies on an unserviced requester callback queue. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador publication, subscription, object registration, If Available acquisition, unconditional divestiture, ownership status, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador discovery, ownership-acquisition, and ownership-unavailable callbacks
